searchText: May I ask how are the different client teams feel with a "pre-devnet-6" launch by end of this week? <@360491619402776577> <@792822129019584562> <@680245613258211336> <@654267572107083777> <@491624610215886849> <@804047680195395675> <@277500722655002624> <@827653956955406406> <@363800010518822915> <@607055410104500244> <@449019668296892420> Still got a few open PRs, that need a review: https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/688075293562503241/1113849056733691924 Geth still can't produce blocks, but we should be able to verify blocks Would be really good to get them merged asap so we have a final spec list in a day or two. expect to have block production working by end of the week? I can get it lodestar<>ethereumjs ready by wednesday so we can have pre-devnet-6 runs (ethereumjs is ready, lodestar need few merges) Same comment as <@360491619402776577> -- from the current list, most things look okay, so aiming for end of week seems plausible. But I don't know if block production would be ready by then (that's something <@804047680195395675> has been working on). But that's the status quo for Nimbus from devnet-5 anyway I landed all the alpha.1 stuff the other day Ok lets try to aim at Thursday launch of the pre devnet 6 then. Hopefully we gonna have block production by ethereumjs at least, and all other clients will be able to join to verify the blocks. All eyes on <@792822129019584562> 👀 <@360491619402776577> if geth can verify block, could you verify if this blockhash of this payload matches: https://github.com/ethereumjs/ethereumjs-monorepo/pull/2750/files#diff-a76b6dcee5e3a2d517d29f68ffde0072b1b7f601eea65d80b5f6d898dc84397c (and is a valid block) (for the excess data gas verification assume parent's excess data gas =0 and data gas used =524288) Prysm is still 2-3 weeks out, but feel free to start without us Besu is good with Thursday for a devnet6 launch Nethermind plan to have an image with block production today-tomorrow Thursday might be a stretch for lighthouse but we'll try! Is there a geth branch in the main repo with support for the latest versions of go-kzg <@360491619402776577> ? Yes Devnet-5 on my fork has the newest devnet 6 spec (i know the naming is weird) Ah thanks, last I checked I was blocked by it, I'll take a look in a bit Ah wait <@360491619402776577> this is on your personal fork, not on the main repo? Yes block prod ready ? The upstream repo should have the new go-kzg as well this is on master? I can try to update I need the version of go-kzg that's compatible with the spec repo trusted setup json yes I think master has that already Not sure, it is untested for now, not sure if it will be by Thurs. Sounds good. I'll assign some validators to some besu nodes then too.
